import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = 1000000007;
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static final int MAXN = 500005;
    static final int M = 105;
    
    static int edgeCnt;
    static int[] head, to, cap, cost, rev, nextEdge;
    static int[] dist, prevEdge, inQueue;
    
    static void addEdge(int a, int b, int c, int w) {
        // forward edge
        to[edgeCnt] = b;
        cap[edgeCnt] = c;
        cost[edgeCnt] = w;
        nextEdge[edgeCnt] = head[a];
        head[a] = edgeCnt;
        rev[edgeCnt] = edgeCnt + 1;
        edgeCnt++;
        
        // backward edge
        to[edgeCnt] = a;
        cap[edgeCnt] = 0;
        cost[edgeCnt] = -w;
        nextEdge[edgeCnt] = head[b];
        head[b] = edgeCnt;
        rev[edgeCnt] = edgeCnt - 1;
        edgeCnt++;
    }
    
    static boolean spfa(int s, int t) {
        Arrays.fill(dist, s, t + 1, INF);
        Arrays.fill(inQueue, s, t + 1, 0);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(s);
        dist[s] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            inQueue[u] = 0;
            for (int i = head[u]; i != -1; i = nextEdge[i]) {
                int j = to[i];
                if (cap[i] > 0 && dist[j] > dist[u] + cost[i]) {
                    dist[j] = dist[u] + cost[i];
                    prevEdge[j] = i;
                    if (inQueue[j] == 0) {
                        inQueue[j] = 1;
                        q.add(j);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return dist[t] < INF;
    }
    
    static int minCostFlow(int s, int t) {
        int cost = 0, flow = 0;
        while (spfa(s, t)) {
            int x = t, f = INF;
            while (x != s) {
                f = Math.min(f, cap[prevEdge[x]]);
                x = to[rev[prevEdge[x]]];
            }
            cost += f * dist[t];
            flow += f;
            x = t;
            while (x != s) {
                cap[prevEdge[x]] -= f;
                cap[rev[prevEdge[x]]] += f;
                x = to[rev[prevEdge[x]]];
            }
        }
        // DEBUG(flow)
        return cost;
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int K = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int C = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int D = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        
        int[] start = new int[K];
        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
            start[i] = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken()) - 1;
        }
        
        int[] roadX = new int[m];
        int[] roadY = new int[m];
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int a = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken()) - 1;
            int b = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken()) - 1;
            roadX[i] = a;
            roadY[i] = b;
        }
        
        int sz = n * M;
        int s = sz;
        int t = sz + 1;
        int totalNodes = sz + 2;
        
        head = new int[totalNodes + 5];
        Arrays.fill(head, -1);
        int maxEdges = (2 * K + 2 * M + 2 * n * (M - 1) + m * (M - 1) * K * 4) * 2 + 10;
        // actually each addEdge adds 2 edges, but we estimate safely
        maxEdges = Math.min(maxEdges, MAXN * 4); // similar to C++ MAXN<<2
        to = new int[maxEdges];
        cap = new int[maxEdges];
        cost = new int[maxEdges];
        rev = new int[maxEdges];
        nextEdge = new int[maxEdges];
        edgeCnt = 0;
        
        dist = new int[totalNodes + 5];
        prevEdge = new int[totalNodes + 5];
        inQueue = new int[totalNodes + 5];
        
        // source to start positions
        for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
            addEdge(s, start[i] * M + 0, 1, 0);
        }
        
        // sink from node 0 at each time
        for (int i = 0; i < M; i++) {
            addEdge(0 * M + i, t, K, C * i);
        }
        
        // staying edges
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < M - 1; j++) {
                addEdge(i * M + j, i * M + j + 1, K, 0);
            }
        }
        
        // road edges
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            int x = roadX[i];
            int y = roadY[i];
            for (int j = 0; j < M - 1; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k < K; k++) {
                int w = D * (2 * k + 1);
                addEdge(x * M + j, y * M + j + 1, 1, w);
                addEdge(y * M + j, x * M + j + 1, 1, w);
            }
        }
        
        int ans = minCostFlow(s, t);
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
